summary: Armstrong World Industries filed an 8-K to announce the appointment of Jennifer O. Kozak as Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer, effective September 9, 2026. The appointment is a routine executive hire, not a forced departure or other special-situation event. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 includes standard commentary from the CEO and Kozak's background. No financial terms, board actions, or strategic implications are disclosed. This is an ordinary personnel announcement with no special-situation characteristics, so the filing is classified as None.
